description: This PHP class `NumberType` extends Symfony's `NumberType` form component to customize the rendering and configuration of number input fields within a form, specifically always displaying it as 'single_text' and allowing additional options like `row_class`, `pre_addon`, and `post_addon`.

classes.name: Goteo\Util\Form\Type\NumberType
classes.description: A custom form type extending Symfony's NumberType to modify default behaviors and add custom options for rendering.

methods.name: getBlockPrefix
methods.description: Returns the custom block prefix 'custom_number' for the form type.

methods.name: configureOptions
methods.description: Sets default options for the form type, including 'row_class', 'pre_addon', 'post_addon', and 'type'.

methods.name: buildView
methods.description: Modifies the form view variables to include custom options for rendering purposes.
